# Forma analysis; lavaan 0.7.3
# R version 4.6.0 (2026-04-24)
# Place the original source file in the working directory.
library(lavaan)

data <- lavaan::HolzingerSwineford1939


fit <- cfa(
  model = "visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3\ntextual =~ x4 + x5 + x6\nspeed =~ x7 + x8 + x9",
  data = data,
  estimator = "ML",
  missing = "listwise",
  fixed.x = FALSE,
  meanstructure = FALSE
)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)

library(lavaan)

data <- lavaan::PoliticalDemocracy


fit <- sem(
  model = "ind60 =~ x1 + x2 + x3\ndem60 =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4\ndem65 =~ y5 + y6 + y7 + y8\ndem60 ~ ind60\ndem65 ~ ind60 + dem60\ny1 ~~ y5\ny2 ~~ y4 + y6\ny3 ~~ y7\ny4 ~~ y8\ny6 ~~ y8",
  data = data,
  estimator = "ML",
  missing = "listwise",
  fixed.x = FALSE,
  meanstructure = FALSE
)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)

# Forma analysis; lavaan 0.7.3
# R version 4.6.0 (2026-04-24)
# Place the original source file in the working directory.
library(lavaan)

i <- seq_len(400)
X <- sin(i*.37) + cos(i*.11)
M <- .6*X + sin(i*.71) + .4*cos(i*.17)
Y <- .45*M + .2*X + cos(i*.53) + .2*sin(i*.29)
data <- data.frame(X, M, Y)


fit <- sem(
  model = "M ~ a*X\nY ~ b*M + cp*X\nind := a*b\ntotal := cp + ind",
  data = data,
  estimator = "ML",
  missing = "listwise",
  fixed.x = FALSE,
  meanstructure = FALSE
)
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
